title: ChangeFlow: Smart approvals and auto-revert policies for model promotions
creator: Asha Patel
description: Purpose: define and deliver an operator-friendly approval lifecycle that gates promotions from shadow -> canary -> general release with configurable smart approvals and deterministic auto-revert behavior. This ticket captures the PM requirements, acceptance criteria, RBAC mapping, rollback triggers, and the handoff to Eng and Design for prototyping in Console. Goal: reduce manual toil during promotions, provide clear audit evidence for compliance, and ensure safe automatic reversion when key quality or reliability signals degrade.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can configure a promotion pipeline with explicit approval stages (shadow->canary, canary->prod) and attach an approval policy per stage.
Approval policy supports: required signers (by role or user), quorum rules (e.g., 2-of-3), maximum approval TTL, and delegated approval windows.
Console shows an immutable audit bundle for each promotion: who approved, timestamp, associated eval snapshot, and pre/post traffic split config.
Auto-rollback runs automatically when one or more configured rollback triggers fire (see rollback_triggers). Rollbacks are executed within the configured SLO window and recorded in the audit bundle.
RBAC roles documented and enforced: approver, operator, auditor. API returns 403 if user lacks role for the requested approval action.
End-to-end QA: simulated shadow->canary promotion with synthetic traffic and a triggered rollback; verify audit logs, notifications, and metrics tagged to the change event.
Docs: short runbook for SREs and on-call with steps to disable auto-rollback, escalate approvals, and perform a manual hotfix promotion.
rollout_policy_summary: Support for chainable stages with per-stage policies. By default we propose: (1) Shadow stage — no promotion without PM+SRE approval if error rate or latency exceeds baseline thresholds. (2) Canary stage — configured percent traffic with health gates; minimum 1 approver from Platform and 1 from Product required for production promotion. Policies are editable templates in Console and exposed via API/CLI for infra automation.
rbac_mappings: approver: can read rollout details, approve promotion stages, view linked evals; assigned to PMs and Team Leads
operator: can execute emergency rollbacks, override non-security signoffs (requires audit), and manage promotion schedules; assigned to SREs and Platform Engineers
auditor: readonly access to audit bundles, can export evidence for compliance; assigned to Security/Compliance teams
delegated_approver: timeboxed permission that can be granted by Admins for a specific promotion window (expires automatically)
rollback_triggers: latency_p95_increase: > 200ms over baseline for 3 consecutive 1m windows
model_quality_regression: automated eval shows > 3% drop on golden prompt set or failing critical prompts
increased_null_responses: > 1% additional empty replies compared to baseline
manual_abort: an operator or approver with override permission can issue immediate rollback
implementation_tasks: Spec: finalize API shape for /rollouts/{id}/approve and /rollouts/{id}/revert (PRD link below) — (Owner: PM)
Console: approval UI with visual evidence bundle and 'approve with comment' flow; support list of signers and TTL — (Owner: Design/Frontend)
Auth: integrate RBAC checks with SSO groups, implement delegated approver token lifecycle — (Owner: ENG-auth)
Automation: server-side engine to evaluate rollback triggers and execute revert with reasons logged — (Owner: ENG-runtime)
Telemetry: tag rollout-related metrics and events; add dashboard for live promotions and autopilot rollbacks — (Owner: ENG-observability)
Tests: e2e harness that replays production-like traffic, injects faults, verifies rollback behavior and audit trail — (Owner: QA)
Docs & Runbook: publish admin guide and incident playbook for manual interventions — (Owner: PM)
Security Review: schedule review with Security and Compliance before feature launch — (Owner: PM/Security)
Phased Rollout: start internal only -> beta customers -> GA; collect feedback at each phase
